text: Envision, a renewable energy and technology company headquartered in Shanghai, became majority owner of the Formula E team then racing as Virgin Racing in April 2018.
short: Envision Group has been the Formula E team's majority owner since 2018.

source.name: Envision Racing: Envision becomes Virgin Racing majority team owner
source.quote: world-leading renewable energy and technology company Envision is to become the majority team owner
source.note: The club's own announcement (28 April 2018 per the site). The same page describes Envision: 'Headquartered in Shanghai, Envision is a global leader in renewable energy generation and smart energy management.'

additionalSources.name: FIA Formula E: Envision Racing welcome Paysafe as new Title Partner
additionalSources.quote: Envision Energy is delighted to have such a wonderful global brand like Paysafe joining Envision as Title Partners of the team
additionalSources.note: Franz Jung, CEO & Chairman of the Board of Envision Racing and VP Envision Energy, speaking for Envision about the team - continued Envision ownership into the 2026 GEN4 era.
